gloss: western part; the west; the American West

definitions.gloss: western part; the west (of a country or region)
definitions.explanation: The western area of a country, prefecture or region; also the American West of frontier history.

examples.english: The western part of the prefecture is mountainous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西部|せいぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: A lot of greenery remains in western Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西部劇|せいぶげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often watched American Westerns on TV with my father.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧{西部|せいぶ}: the western part of the prefecture
- {西部劇|せいぶげき}: a Western (cowboy film)
- {西部|せいぶ}⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧: the settlement of the American West
- {西部|せいぶ}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: the western region

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{西側|にしがわ}→西側：27563_nishigawa⟧: the west side of something; also "the West" in Cold War politics
- ⟦{東部|とうぶ}→東部：32584_toubu⟧: the eastern part, the opposite
